boxes.meaning: sport set of top and trousers

english.meaning: sport set of top and trousers
english.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday term for a tracksuit or sports outfit.

examples.english: I usually wear a tracksuit to go running; it makes warming up convenient.
examples.traditional: 我通常着運動服去跑步，方便熱身。
